scope: Same binary calls the actual public long-prefill FP16 packed operand / existing Gemm::f16 F32 output API and carve over a guarded arena and actual public query8/head-parallel original-FP32 control. Frame gemm identifies which operand oracle is used; control requires whole baseline score/ID bits and leaves GEMM scratch unchanged. Globally unused row-suffix canaries follow union of all reused tiles. Sampled double oracle uses FP16-rounded operands, prospective gamma128 FP32 bound; exact original dead-key bits for every query; independent full-row top-k, complete pack and guard checks, status checked after every drained call outside timing. Fault mode injects finite-out-of-half-range, Inf and NaN, checks nonzero status and its survival across restored finite calls; scope counts distinguish negative coverage from positive-only cases. Original FP32 score and selected-ID changes are observations, not a parity or model quality gate. Positive active only; explicit in-order GPU queue. Timing is submit+wait monotonic/thread CPU, not device-only time or utilization. Library internal allocations, XMX lowering, task quality, full-model context/RESTORE and end-to-end PP remain unqualified.
